passive.name: Game Changer
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer enters combat or uses Ultimate on an ally target, the wearer gains "Great Fortune" for **3** turn(s). While the wearer holds "Great Fortune," all allies' CRIT Rate increases by **10/11/12/13/14%**, CRIT DMG increases by **30/37.5/45/52.5/60%**, and the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**.
At the start of each wave, the wearer regenerates a fixed amount of **15** Energy.

passive.name: Opening
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **20/25/30/35/40%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, increases the target's Elation stat by **12/15/18/21/24%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Rumble
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by **6/7/8/9/10%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Companion
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases all allies' Elation by **8/9/10/11/12%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG = HP%
skillPriority: Ultimate > Elation Skill = Talent > Basic = Skill
tracePriority: Aha, Sic 'Em! (A6) > Screw It, We Ball (A4) > On Cloud Nine (A2)

entries.name: Make Some Noise
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Let the Storm Rage On
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **60%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains **20** point(s) of "Certified Banger."

entries.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
entries.text:
Gains **5** Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by **50%** for **3** turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain **10** point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of **20** Punchline point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.
If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by **50%**.

entries.name: That Smile Hits Different
entries.text:
After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of **10** Energy and gains **3** Punchline point(s).
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals **30%** Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.

entries.name: We Are So Back!
entries.text:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by **30%**.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by **20%**.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
entries.text: Deals **8** instances of DMG, with each instance dealing **20%** Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals **60%** Lightning Elation DMG, which is split evenly among all enemies.

entries.name: On Cloud Nine
entries.text: For every **200** point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds **1000**, increases this unit's Elation stat by **10%**, up to a maximum increase of **60%**.

entries.name: Screw It, We Ball
entries.text: Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by **15%**. After using Ultimate, recovers **1** Skill Point(s) for the team.

entries.name: Aha, Sic 'Em!
entries.text: After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains **2** point(s) of "Certified Banger" the next time they use their Skill.

entries.name: Believe In the Light
entries.text: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "Certified Banger" gained by ally targets by 2. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).

entries.name: History in the Making...
entries.text: Ultimate additionally increases the Elation of one designated ally by 12%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Into the Spotlight
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Save the World. Just Because.
entries.text: When using Elation Skill, increases the DMG taken by enemy targets by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Love & Courage: Always in Style
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: The Cosmic Legend Cometh!
entries.text: When using Elation Skill, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 100% for 3 turns.
